deadlines.quote: All applications are due by 5:00 PM local time of applicant organization.

match.quote: This NOFO does not require cost sharing as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement

award.quote: The NHLBI intends to fund up to 20 new R35 awards per year in Fiscal Years 2026, 2027, and 2028. Award Budget Applications may request up to $700,000 direct costs per year.

sections.name: Biographical Sketch
sections.quote: The PD/PI must, in the Biographical Sketch, address these considerations and demonstrate a history of conducting rigorous and reproducible research and reporting it in a transparent fashion.

sections.name: Research Strategy
sections.quote: Research Strategy : The Research Strategy should include the following information: 1. Background regarding the area(s) of research proposed and key gaps in our understanding

sections.name: Resource Sharing Plan
sections.quote: Resource Sharing Plan : Individuals are required to comply with the instructions for the Resource Sharing Plans

sections.name: Data Management and Sharing Plan
sections.quote: All applications, regardless of the amount of direct costs requested for any one year, must address a Data Management and Sharing Plan.

criteria.name: NOFO emphasis: PD/PI previous contributions, outstanding HLBS productivity, and potential for continued impact
criteria.quote: reviewers will emphasize the following: 1. Evidence of important previous contributions made by the PD/PI to their field

criteria.name: Significance
criteria.quote: Significance Does the project address an important problem or a critical barrier to progress in the field?

criteria.name: Investigator(s)
criteria.quote: Investigator(s) Are the PD(s)/PI(s), collaborators, and other researchers well suited to the project?

criteria.name: Innovation
criteria.quote: Innovation Does the application challenge and seek to shift current research or clinical practice paradigms

criteria.name: Approach
criteria.quote: Approach Are the overall strategy, methodology, and analyses well-reasoned and appropriate to accomplish the specific aims of the project?

criteria.name: Environment
criteria.quote: Environment Will the scientific environment in which the work will be done contribute to the probability of success?

criteria.name: Study Timeline
criteria.quote: Study Timeline Specific to applications involving clinical trials Is the study timeline described in detail

criteria.name: Protections for Human Subjects
criteria.quote: For research that involves human subjects but does not involve one of the categories of research that are exempt under 45 CFR Part 46

criteria.name: Inclusion of Women, Minorities, and Individuals Across the Lifespan
criteria.quote: Inclusion of Women, Minorities, and Individuals Across the Lifespan When the proposed project involves human subjects and/or NIH-defined clinical research

criteria.name: Vertebrate Animals
criteria.quote: The committee will evaluate the involvement of live vertebrate animals as part of the scientific assessment

criteria.name: Biohazards
criteria.quote: Biohazards Reviewers will assess whether materials or procedures proposed are potentially hazardous to research personnel and/or the environment

criteria.name: Applications from Foreign Organizations
criteria.quote: Applications from Foreign Organizations Reviewers will assess whether the project presents special opportunities

criteria.name: Select Agent Research
criteria.quote: Select Agent Research Reviewers will assess the information provided in this section of the application

criteria.name: Resource Sharing Plans
criteria.quote: Resource Sharing Plans Reviewers will comment on whether the Resource Sharing Plan(s)

criteria.name: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
criteria.quote: For projects involving key biological and/or chemical resources, reviewers will comment on the brief plans proposed

criteria.name: Budget and Period of Support
criteria.quote: Reviewers will consider whether the budget and the requested period of support are fully justified and reasonable in relation to the proposed research.

other: Page limits follow the How to Apply - Application Guide and the Table of Page Limits
Specific Aims are not required and must not be submitted
Letter of Support must not exceed 2 pages
Only limited Appendix materials; no publications or other material except blank questionnaires or blank surveys
Budget may not request more than 7 years of support (10-year form provided)
Applications must be submitted electronically; paper applications will not be accepted

eligibility.item: Eligible organizations: higher education institutions, nonprofits, for-profits (incl. small businesses), state/county/city/township/special district governments, tribal governments, eligible federal agencies, U.S. territories, independent school districts, public/Indian housing authorities, tribal organizations, faith- or community-based organizations, and regional organizations
eligibility.quote: Higher Education Institutions Public/State Controlled Institutions of Higher Education Private Institutions of Higher Education

eligibility.item: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) entities are not eligible to apply
eligibility.quote: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) Entities (Foreign Organizations) are not eligible to apply.

eligibility.item: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) components of U.S. organizations are not eligible to apply
eligibility.quote: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) components of U.S. Organizations are not eligible to apply.

eligibility.item: Foreign components, as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement, are allowed
eligibility.quote: Foreign components, as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement , are allowed.

eligibility.item: Only single PD/PI applications are allowed; multiple-PD/PI applications will not be accepted
eligibility.quote: Only single PD/PI applications are allowed. Applications with multiple PDs/PIs will not be accepted.

eligibility.item: PD/PI must currently be PD/PI on at least two NHLBI R01-equivalent (R01, DP1, or DP2) awards
eligibility.quote: Are currently PD/PI on at least two NHLBI R01-equivalent (defined here as R01, DP1, or DP2) awards.

eligibility.item: At least one qualifying R01-equivalent award must be single-PD/PI, not in a no-cost extension, and not an NIH-defined clinical trial unless mechanistic or BESH
eligibility.quote: At least one of the R01-equivalent awards must meet all the following requirements : Be a single-PD/PI award, AND Not be in a no-cost extension (NCE), AND Not be an NIH-defined clinical trial

eligibility.item: One of the qualifying awards must be an NHLBI-funded NIH Early Stage Investigator (ESI) R01
eligibility.quote: One of the awards must be an NHLBI-funded NIH Early Stage Investigator (ESI) R01.

eligibility.item: PD/PI must commit a minimum of six person months throughout the EIA
eligibility.quote: The PD/PI must commit a minimum of six person months

eligibility.item: Only New applications are allowed
eligibility.quote: Application Types Allowed New The OER Glossary and the How to Apply - Application Guide provide details on these application types.

eligibility.item: Research must be within the scope of the NHLBI mission; research outside it is not responsive
eligibility.quote: Research outside the scope of the NHLBI mission ; and Research that includes Phase I, II, III, or T4 non-mechanistic clinical trials

eligibility.item: Phase I, II, III, and T4 non-mechanistic clinical trials are not permitted; mechanistic trials and BESH studies are permitted
eligibility.quote: However, Phase I, II, III, and T4 non-mechanistic clinical trials are not permitted under this NOFO.

eligibility.item: Applications missing the AOR Letter of Support are not responsive and will not be reviewed
eligibility.quote: Applications missing Letters of Support will be considered not responsive and will not proceed to review.

eligibility.item: Do not propose research that fits within the mission of other NIH Institutes and Centers
eligibility.quote: applicants should not propose research that fits appropriately within the mission of other NIH Institutes and Centers (ICs).

eligibility.item: Organizations may submit more than one application only if each is scientifically distinct
eligibility.quote: Applicant organizations may submit more than one application, provided that each application is scientifically distinct.

eligibility.item: A new (A0) application is not accepted before the summary statement issues for an overlapping A0 or A1 application
eligibility.quote: A new (A0) application that is submitted before issuance of the summary statement from the review of an

eligibility.item: A resubmission (A1) is not accepted before the summary statement issues for the previous A0 application
eligibility.quote: A resubmission (A1) application that is submitted before issuance of the summary statement from the

eligibility.item: An application substantially overlapping another application pending appeal of initial peer review is not accepted
eligibility.quote: An application that has substantial overlap with another application pending appeal of initial peer review

eligibility.item: All organizational registrations must be completed before the application is submitted (allow 6 weeks or more)
eligibility.quote: All registrations must be completed prior to the application being submitted. Registration can take 6 weeks or more

eligibility.item: Maintain an active SAM registration, renewed at least annually
eligibility.quote: Applicants must complete and maintain an active registration, which requires renewal at least annually .

eligibility.item: Foreign organizations must obtain an NCAGE code to register in SAM
eligibility.quote: Foreign organizations must obtain an NCAGE code (in lieu of a CAGE code) in order to register in SAM.

eligibility.item: Use the same UEI for all registrations and on the grant application
eligibility.quote: The same UEI must be used for all registrations, as well as on the grant application.

eligibility.item: Organization must register in eRA Commons with at least one Signing Official and one PD/PI account
eligibility.quote: eRA Commons requires organizations to identify at least one Signing Official (SO) and at least one Program Director/Principal Investigator (PD/PI) account

eligibility.item: Organization must complete Grants.gov registration (requires active SAM registration)
eligibility.quote: Applicants must have an active SAM registration in order to complete the Grants.gov registration.

eligibility.item: PD/PI must have an eRA Commons account affiliated with the applicant organization
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must have an eRA Commons account.

eligibility.item: A PD/PI who is also the organizational Signing Official must have two distinct eRA Commons accounts
eligibility.quote: If the PD/PI is also the organizational Signing Official, they must have two distinct eRA Commons accounts, one for each role.

eligibility.item: PD/PI must enter their eRA Commons ID in the Credential field of the Senior/Key Person Profile form
eligibility.quote: All PD(s)/PI(s) must include their eRA Commons ID in the Credential field of the Senior/Key Person Profile form .
